instruction: SCOPE: you are ONLY authorized to test https://vault.kervia.ch (this exact host, our own Kervia-vault secrets vault). Do NOT touch any other domain, IP, service or port on this network. Kervia-vault is a secrets vault: REST API /v1/* (Bearer av_ API keys), MCP /mcp, admin webui /ui/* and /admin/* (session cookie), first-boot setup /setup/*. Attack surfaces to assess: authentication (Argon2id API keys, bcrypt admin login, recovery codes), access control (per-vault grants — try IDOR between vaults with one valid agent key), the setup wizard flow, rate limiting, session handling, template validation, and any injection on the REST/MCP inputs. There are NO valid credentials in scope: attempt unauthenticated recon, auth bypass, and logic flaws only — do not brute-force passwords (rate limits are intentional and tested). Report every finding with a PoC.
